list.name: Scraper failures
list.rawSql:
SELECT started_at AS time,
       COALESCE(finished_at, started_at + INTERVAL '15 minutes') AS time_end,
       COALESCE(NULLIF(left(error, 160), ''), 'run failed') AS text
FROM scrape_runs
WHERE status = 'error'
  AND $__timeFilter(started_at)

description: Everything about ads that disappeared — the closest thing olx.ba offers to sold prices. Exit prices are last ASKING prices observed before removal, not transaction prices.

panels.title: Closed listings · 30 d
panels.description: Ads gone from every configured search in the last month.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*)
FROM listings_closed_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], ${min_sqm:int}, ${max_sqm:int}, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]) l
WHERE l.closed_at > now() - INTERVAL '30 days'
  AND room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
  AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])

panels.title: Median exit KM/m² · closed 30 d
panels.description: Last asking price per m² before removal — not a transaction price.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.closing_ppm2)
FROM listings_closed_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], ${min_sqm:int}, ${max_sqm:int}, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]) l
WHERE l.closed_at > now() - INTERVAL '30 days'
  AND l.closing_ppm2 > 0
  AND room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
  AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])

panels.title: Sell-through rate · 30 d
panels.description: Closed ads ÷ (closed + active) over the last month — how much of current supply is leaving.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT count(*)::float AS n FROM listings_closed_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], ${min_sqm:int}, ${max_sqm:int}, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]) l
  WHERE l.closed_at > now() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]) AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])
),
a AS (
  SELECT count(*)::float AS n FROM listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], ${min_sqm:int}, ${max_sqm:int}, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]) l
  WHERE room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]) AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])
)
SELECT COALESCE(round(c.n / NULLIF(c.n + a.n, 0) * 100), 0) FROM c, a

panels.title: Median days on market · closed 30 d
panels.description: Published/first-seen → closed for ads that exited this month. A lower bound until published_at converges.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lc.days_listed)
FROM listings_closed_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], ${min_sqm:int}, ${max_sqm:int}, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]) l
JOIN v_listing_lifecycle lc ON lc.article_id = l.article_id
WHERE l.closed_at > now() - INTERVAL '30 days'
  AND room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
  AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])

panels.title: Exit KM/m² vs asking KM/m² — daily medians
panels.description: Green line: exit askings of ads that closed. Blue: pooled reconstructed daily inventory asking median for the selected filters. Estimated, stale and provisional fields expose historical availability quality.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', l.closed_at) AS time,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.closing_ppm2) AS "exit KM/m2 (closed ads)"
FROM listings_closed_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], ${min_sqm:int}, ${max_sqm:int}, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]) l
WHERE l.closing_ppm2 > 0
  AND $__timeFilter(l.closed_at)
  AND room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
  AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo' AS time,
       median AS "asking KM/m2 (daily inventory)",
       priced_count AS "priced sample",
       estimated_count AS "estimated",
       stale_count AS "stale",
       provisional_day AS "provisional"
FROM market_daily_filtered(
  date($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo'),
  date($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo'),
  ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}],
  NULLIF('${min_sqm}', '')::numeric,
  NULLIF('${max_sqm}', '')::numeric,
  ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}],
  ARRAY(SELECT CASE WHEN selected = 'sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE selected END FROM unnest(ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]) AS t(selected)),
  ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}])
ORDER BY day

panels.title: Days on market — closed listings
panels.description: How long ads survived before disappearing, in the selected period.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN lc.days_listed <= 7  THEN '0-7 d'
            WHEN lc.days_listed <= 14 THEN '8-14 d'
            WHEN lc.days_listed <= 30 THEN '15-30 d'
            WHEN lc.days_listed <= 60 THEN '31-60 d'
            ELSE '60+ d' END AS bucket,
       count(*) AS exits
FROM listings_closed_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], ${min_sqm:int}, ${max_sqm:int}, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]) l
JOIN v_listing_lifecycle lc ON lc.article_id = l.article_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(l.closed_at)
  AND room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
  AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY min(lc.days_listed)

panels.title: Recently closed — exit price vs original ask
panels.description: change_pct compares the final asking price with the first one we observed. Negative (red) = exited below its original ask.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT l.title, l.url, l.location, l.sqm, l.rooms,
       l.closing_price, l.closing_ppm2, lc.opening_price,
       round(l.closing_price - lc.opening_price) AS price_change,
       CASE WHEN lc.opening_price > 0
            THEN round((l.closing_price - lc.opening_price) / lc.opening_price * 100)::int END AS change_pct,
       lc.days_listed, l.closed_at
FROM listings_closed_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], ${min_sqm:int}, ${max_sqm:int}, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]) l
JOIN v_listing_lifecycle lc ON lc.article_id = l.article_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(l.closed_at)
  AND room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
  AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])
ORDER BY l.closed_at DESC
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Exits by room count
panels.description: Which apartment sizes are actually leaving the market in the selected period.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT room_bucket(l.rooms) AS bucket, count(*) AS exits
FROM listings_closed_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], ${min_sqm:int}, ${max_sqm:int}, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]) l
WHERE $__timeFilter(l.closed_at)
  AND room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
  AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Exit map — click a pin to open the ad
panels.description: Last known pin of ads that closed in the selected period.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT l.latitude, l.longitude, l.title, l.url,
       l.closing_price, l.closing_ppm2, l.closed_at,
       l.location AS location
FROM listings_closed_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], ${min_sqm:int}, ${max_sqm:int}, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]) l
WHERE l.latitude IS NOT NULL AND l.longitude IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(l.closed_at)
  AND room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
  AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])

panels.title: Closed & pinned — click title to open
panels.description: Table form of the exit map: closed ads that had pins. Click a title to open the ad on olx.ba.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT l.title, l.url, l.closing_price, l.closing_ppm2, l.closed_at,
       l.latitude, l.longitude
FROM listings_closed_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], ${min_sqm:int}, ${max_sqm:int}, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]) l
WHERE l.latitude IS NOT NULL AND l.longitude IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(l.closed_at)
  AND room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
  AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])
ORDER BY l.closed_at DESC
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Exit discount vs original ask
panels.description: How final asks compared to the first price we saw. Flat market → most ads exit at their opening ask.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN CASE WHEN lc.opening_price > 0
            THEN round((l.closing_price - lc.opening_price) / lc.opening_price * 100)::int END IS NULL THEN '(unknown)'
            WHEN CASE WHEN lc.opening_price > 0
            THEN round((l.closing_price - lc.opening_price) / lc.opening_price * 100)::int END <= -20 THEN '-20 % or worse'
            WHEN CASE WHEN lc.opening_price > 0
            THEN round((l.closing_price - lc.opening_price) / lc.opening_price * 100)::int END <= -10 THEN '-10..-20 %'
            WHEN CASE WHEN lc.opening_price > 0
            THEN round((l.closing_price - lc.opening_price) / lc.opening_price * 100)::int END < 0 THEN '0..-10 %'
            WHEN CASE WHEN lc.opening_price > 0
            THEN round((l.closing_price - lc.opening_price) / lc.opening_price * 100)::int END = 0 THEN 'flat'
            ELSE 'raised' END AS bucket,
       count(*) AS exits
FROM listings_closed_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], ${min_sqm:int}, ${max_sqm:int}, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]) l
JOIN v_listing_lifecycle lc ON lc.article_id = l.article_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(l.closed_at)
  AND room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
  AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Sell-through rate — weekly · all categories
panels.description: Weekly priced-share proxy from filtered reconstructed listing-day inventory. It is not a transaction rate; inferred, stale and provisional rows are part of the historical availability model.

targets.rawSql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT d.day,
         count(*)::numeric AS inventory,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.price_state = 'valid')::numeric AS priced
  FROM v_listing_daily d
  WHERE d.day BETWEEN date($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')
                  AND date($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')

  AND (COALESCE(cardinality(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]), 0) = 0
    OR d.category_memberships && ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]
    OR d.category = ANY (ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]))
  AND ('${min_sqm}' = '' OR d.sqm IS NULL OR d.sqm >= NULLIF('${min_sqm}', '')::numeric)
  AND ('${max_sqm}' = '' OR d.sqm IS NULL OR d.sqm <= NULLIF('${max_sqm}', '')::numeric)
  AND (COALESCE(cardinality(ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]), 0) = 0
    OR d.rooms = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
    OR room_bucket(d.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]))
  AND d.deal = ANY (ARRAY(SELECT CASE WHEN selected = 'sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE selected END FROM unnest(ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]) AS t(selected)))
  AND (COALESCE(cardinality(ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]), 0) = 0
    OR d.neighborhood = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}])
    OR d.location = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]))
  GROUP BY d.day
), weekly AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('week', day::timestamp)::date AS week,
         avg(inventory) AS inventory,
         avg(priced) AS priced
  FROM daily GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT week::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo' AS time,
       round(100.0 * priced / NULLIF(inventory, 0), 2) AS "sell-through %"
FROM weekly ORDER BY week

panels.title: Days on market vs exit discount · sales
panels.description: Each closed sale ad as a point: how long it sat (x) vs how its final asking price compared to the first one we saw (y). Points drifting downward to the right = stale ads exiting at bigger discounts. Days-on-market is a lower bound until published_at converges; exit prices are askings, not transactions.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT lc.days_listed AS days_on_market,
       round(100.0 * (l.closing_price - lc.opening_price) / NULLIF(lc.opening_price, 0), 1)::double precision AS exit_vs_opening_pct
FROM listings_closed_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], ${min_sqm:int}, ${max_sqm:int}, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]) l
JOIN v_listing_lifecycle lc ON lc.article_id = l.article_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(l.closed_at)
  AND lc.opening_price > 0 AND l.closing_price IS NOT NULL AND lc.days_listed IS NOT NULL
  AND room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
  AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])

panels.title: Exit rate by KM/m² bracket · 30 d
panels.description: Share of ads that exited per price bracket, brackets cut at the live quartiles of the combined active+closed pool. Cheap segments may be high-churn; expensive ones may just sit.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT l.closing_ppm2 AS ppm2
  FROM listings_closed_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], ${min_sqm:int}, ${max_sqm:int}, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]) l
  WHERE l.closing_ppm2 > 0 AND l.closed_at > now() - INTERVAL '30 days'
    AND room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
    AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])
),
a AS (
  SELECT l.ppm2 AS ppm2
  FROM listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], ${min_sqm:int}, ${max_sqm:int}, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]) l
  WHERE l.ppm2 > 0
    AND room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
    AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2) AS q25,
         percentile_cont(0.5)  WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2) AS q50,
         percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2) AS q75
  FROM (SELECT ppm2 FROM c UNION ALL SELECT ppm2 FROM a) p
),
tagged AS (
  SELECT 'exit' AS kind, ppm2 FROM c
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'active', ppm2 FROM a
)
SELECT CASE WHEN t.ppm2 < b.q25 THEN 'Q1 · cheapest'
            WHEN t.ppm2 < b.q50 THEN 'Q2'
            WHEN t.ppm2 < b.q75 THEN 'Q3'
            ELSE 'Q4 · priciest' END AS bucket,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.kind = 'exit') / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1)::double precision AS exits_pct
FROM tagged t CROSS JOIN bounds b
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Exit rate by neighborhood — 30 d
panels.description: Closed ÷ (closed + active) per district over the last month — which areas actually move vs which sit. District from the ad pin; needs ≥10 combined listings; respects Category/Rooms/Deal but not the Neighborhood filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ex AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN l.latitude IS NULL THEN '(no pin)'
              ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(l.location, ''), '(unmapped)') END AS district,
         count(*)::int AS closed_n
  FROM listings_closed_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], ${min_sqm:int}, ${max_sqm:int}, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]) l
  WHERE l.closed_at > now() - INTERVAL '30 days'
    AND room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
    AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])
  GROUP BY 1
),
ac AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN l.latitude IS NULL THEN '(no pin)'
              ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(l.location, ''), '(unmapped)') END AS district,
         count(*)::int AS active_n
  FROM listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}], ${min_sqm:int}, ${max_sqm:int}, ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]) l
  WHERE room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}])
    AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}])
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT ex.district, ex.closed_n AS closed_30d, ac.active_n AS actives,
       round(100.0 * ex.closed_n / NULLIF(ex.closed_n + ac.active_n, 0), 1)::double precision AS exit_rate_pct
FROM ex
LEFT JOIN ac USING (district)
WHERE ex.closed_n + COALESCE(ac.active_n, 0) >= 10
ORDER BY exit_rate_pct DESC
